about_the_game:
Minipo is a fun and simple platform game designed for children.
In the game, you’ll join our character Minipo on exciting adventures across 5 different worlds and 25 unique levels.
The difficulty increases gradually from easy to hard as you progress.

The main goal is to reach the final level and reunite Minipo with his rabbit friends.
Of course, before that, you’ll face many challenges — water and fire obstacles, monsters, and evil mushrooms that will try to stop you.
But the game becomes even more fun along the way!

Most importantly, you can collect grapes, cherries, and apples to gain fire power.
With this fire power, you can defeat the monsters in the game!

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (dual-core, 2.0 GHz or higher) or Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
